about.title: Cleaning
about.desc: Cleaning is the process of professional cleaning and maintaining cleanliness in various premises, such as residential homes, offices, commercial buildings, hotels, medical institutions, and more.
about.goals: The main goals of cleaning include:

goals_list.4: Extending the life of the property
goals_list.8: Compliance with sanitary and hygienic requirements

about.why_us_text:
When clients choose us
for their cleaning needs, they get:
about.professionalism_text: Our staff has many years of experience and regularly undergoes training to provide the highest level of service.
about.quality_text: We use only tested and high-quality products and equipment to ensure cleanliness and safety.
about.individual_text: We tailor our services to the specific needs and requirements of each client.
about.flexibility_text: We offer a variety of packages and schedules to best meet the needs of our clients.
about.eco_text: We care about nature and use environmentally friendly cleaning products.
about.trust: Our clients can be sure of cleanliness and order by entrusting their property to us.

price.title: Cleaning prices
price.foot1: Surcharge on the base price: from 15% to 100% on holidays, adverse conditions, night work, stairs, heavy dirt or express order.
price.foot2: All prices may increase after inspection of the site, depending on the degree of contamination and access for cleaning.
price.foot5: If you do not see the cleaning prices you are interested in, contact us.
price.kitchen_full: Full kitchen cleaning (inside and outside cleaning of cabinets, oven, stove, and extractor hood)
price.repair_paint: Removal of paint, silicone, splashes and traces of paint, glue, foam and silicone, grout residue on tiles and faience.
price.repair_dust: Dust removal from walls, washing windows, sills, ceilings, cabinets, switches, frames, polishing all surfaces, etc.
price.repair_full: Full cleaning of floor coverings. Washing of windows and frames. Complete cleaning of sanitary facilities.
price.floor_wet: Manual wet cleaning of hard floor coverings
price.window_low: Professional cleaning of windows and shop windows one-sided (up to 3m height)
price.window_high: Professional cleaning of windows and shop windows one-sided (over 3m height)
price.window_after: Cleaning of windows and frames after major repairs, removal of stickers, paint and heavy dirt

pricebeginning.plan_desc:
We provide comprehensive cleaning services,
tailored to your needs — from one-time to regular.

package3_list.1: Dry and wet cleaning of all floor coverings
package3_list.3: Kitchen cleaning. Cabinets (outside); fridge, oven, microwave, etc. outside.
package3_list.5: Doors and frames, lighting fixtures, switches and sockets

package4_list.2: Dry and wet cleaning of all floor coverings
package4_list.4: Kitchen cleaning. Cabinets (outside); fridge, oven, microwave, etc. outside.
package4_list.6: Doors and frames, lighting fixtures, switches and sockets

package5_list.1: Window cleaning — glass and frames, balconies
package5_list.2: Dry and wet cleaning of all floor coverings
package5_list.4: Kitchen cleaning. Internal cleaning of cabinets, fridge, oven, microwave, air conditioner, etc.
package5_list.6: Doors and frames, lighting fixtures, switches and sockets

regular_list.1: Daily, weekly or monthly cleaning of residential and commercial premises.
regular_list.2: Maintaining the cleanliness of offices, shops, hotels and other commercial sites.

general_list.1: Deep cleaning of all surfaces, including hard-to-reach places.
general_list.2: Window cleaning, carpet and furniture cleaning, dusting ceilings and walls.

afterrepair_list.1: Removal of construction dust and debris.
afterrepair_list.2: Cleaning all surfaces from paint, glue and other construction materials.

afterevent_list.1: Cleaning after corporate events, parties, trade shows and other public events.

special_list.1: Dry cleaning of carpets, furniture and curtains.
special_list.2: Polishing and care of floors (parquet, marble, tiles, etc.).
special_list.3: Cleaning and disinfection of bathrooms and kitchens.

disinfection_list.1: Comprehensive disinfection of premises to remove bacteria and viruses.
disinfection_list.2: Antibacterial treatment of premises for medical and food service.

eco_list.1: Use of environmentally friendly cleaning products.
eco_list.2: Services for clients who care about the environment.

individual_list.1: Development of individual cleaning plans depending on the specifics and needs of the client.
